src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Authenticator setup link
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Builds the link an authenticator app scans to start giving a person their sign-in codes.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Signing key text
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Small holder for a signing key given as text.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Extra-check pass store
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Keeps extra-check approvals in shared storage so each can be used once and is cancelled on sign-out.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Stay-signed-in pass
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: How a stay-signed-in pass is stored: it is replaced on each use and records why it was cancelled.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Old pass cleanup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Deletes expired stay-signed-in passes from the database.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Code step challenge
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: What a correct password earns a person with two-step sign-in: a short-lived prompt to enter their code.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Code step answers
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: The shared failure answers the code step, extra checks and password changes give back.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Code proof check
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Checks the code half of an extra check or password change after the password has been accepted.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Extra-check approvals
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Re-asks for a password (and code) before a sensitive action and hands out a single-use approval.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Temporary password maker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Generates a strong random password for emergency account recovery.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Equal-time password check
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Makes a skipped password check take as long as a real one so attackers cannot tell if a user exists.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Authenticator code matcher
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Checks a six-digit authenticator code and rejects one that was already used.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Two-step credentials
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Stores and checks each person's authenticator key and recovery codes, and is the only code that does so.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: User record lock
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Locks a person's record while two-step settings change so two changes cannot collide.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Connected apps
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Lists the outside apps a person has allowed in, shows when each last acted, and revokes them.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Connected app record settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Adds a creation time to each connected app's record so unapproved ones can expire.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Approval record settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Adds a last-used time to each approval so Connected apps can show when an app last acted.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Connected app cleanup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Removes expired app registrations and old approvals from the database.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: App sign-in server
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Sets up the sign-in server that lets outside apps, such as AI assistants, be approved to use a farm's data.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Role assignments store
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Reads and saves which roles each user holds and which flocks they are limited to.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.name: Connected app rules
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.description: Defines what an outside app may be and checks its details, such as where it may send people back.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.name: App details lookup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.description: Handles apps that identify themselves by a web address, fetching and validating their published details.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.name: App details fetcher
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/OAuth/Clien.description: Downloads an app's published details from a web address it supplied, with guards against reaching internal addresses.
